meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成支持备注和跳转的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常要把资料整理成可演示的幻灯片
copy.tagline_en: Turn your content into a presentation deck with speaker notes and branching.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn rough notes into a navigable slide deck for presenting.

howto.what: 装好后,当你让它做演示文稿时,它会产出一个可导航浏览的幻灯片(deck),不是渲染好的视频。每页可带演讲者备注,支持内容逐段揭示、点击热点跳转分支,也能把现有网页改造成幻灯片。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做幻灯片或 HyperFrames 幻灯片时直接执行;若你只是说'演示文稿''pitch deck''把网页转成幻灯片'等,它会先说明并确认,你同意才做。

say.text: 帮我把这份大纲做成一个幻灯片 deck
say.note: 会直接开始制作可导航的 deck。

say.text: 把这篇网页文章转换成可演示的幻灯片
say.note: 会先确认,并尽量保留原设计。

say.text: 给我的投资方案做一个带演讲者备注的 pitch deck
say.note: 会生成交互式 deck 并含热点跳转。

howto.what_en: Produces a navigable deck (not a video) for presentations. Slides support presenter notes, fragment reveals, hotspot branching. Can also convert an existing page into a deck.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for a slideshow or HyperFrames slideshow. For adjacent requests like 'presentation', 'pitch deck', or 'convert this page', it asks for confirmation first.

say_en.text: Turn this outline into a slide deck.
say_en.note: It starts building the navigable deck.

say_en.text: Convert this web article into a presentation.
say_en.note: It confirms first and keeps the original design.

say_en.text: Make a pitch deck with speaker notes for my plan.
